title: Count-based differential expression analysis of RNA-seq data
summary: A source-faithful BioLang port of BDSR chapter 12 using the exact airway data, all fourteen exercises, independently regenerated historical DESeq2 results, and BioLang-generated analytical plots.

source.title: Stephen D. Turner, Ph.D. — Biological Data Science with R: Count-Based Differential Expression Analysis of RNA-seq Data
source.note: Non-commercial BioLang adaptation under CC BY-NC 4.0. It preserves the source sequence, exercises, exact data and historical DESeq2 outputs while generating every analytical plot in BioLang; no published analytical figure image is copied. Dataset and generated oracle files retain their separate terms and attribution. This is not an official BDSR publication or endorsement.
